name: 1X Technologies
description: 1X Technologies is a Norwegian-American robotics company developing general-purpose humanoid robots for home and industrial environments. Founded in 2014 by Bernt Øivind Børnich as Halodi Robotics, rebranded in 2022. Headquartered in Palo Alto, California with manufacturing in Hayward, CA and Moss, Norway. Raised $130M+ from OpenAI Startup Fund, EQT Ventures, and Tiger Global. Strategic partnership with EQT for up to 10,000 NEO humanoid deployments across 300+ portfolio companies (2026-2030).

name: ABB Robotics
description: ABB Robotics is part of ABB and operates from its headquarters in Zurich, Switzerland; the robotics division was founded in 1974, and today employs roughly 7,000 people, with its official web presence at https://new.abb.com/robotics.

name: AgiBot
description: AgiBot’s official website is https://www.agibot.com; the company is headquartered in Shanghai, China, was founded in February 2023, and employs a team of roughly 100 plus staff members.

name: Agility Robotics
description: Agility Robotics was founded in 2015, is headquartered in Salem, Oregon, operates its official website at agilityrobotics.com, and employs roughly 300 people (approximately 294 employees).

name: ANYbotics
description: ANYbotics AG, a Swiss robotics company founded in 2016, is headquartered in Zürich, Switzerland, and operates its official website at www.anybotics.com. The firm employs roughly 236 people.

name: Apptronik
description: Apptronik’s official website is apptronik.com; the company is headquartered in Austin, Texas (11701 Stonehollow Drive Suite 150, Austin, TX 78758, United States); it was founded in 2016; and it currently employs roughly 300 people.

name: AUBO Robotics
description: AUBO Robotics’ official website is www.aubo-robotics.com; the company is headquartered in the Haidian district of Beijing, China, was founded in 2015, and employs roughly 51 to 200 people.

name: Beijing HRIC
description: Beijing HRIC specializes in the design and development of humanoid robots, combining artificial intelligence, advanced mechanics, and interactive technology. With a commitment to practical deployment and industry integration, their Tiangong humanoid robots are positioned to redefine automation across various sectors.

name: Boston Dynamics
description: Boston Dynamics (official website bostondynamics.com) is a robotics company founded in 1992, headquartered at 200 Smith Street, Suite 4100 in Waltham, Massachusetts, USA, and employs roughly 730 people.

name: Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center
description: Chengdu Humanoid Robot Innovation Center develops humanoid robotics technologies and products, including TP-01, J-PANDA, KonKa, TangPa, and other robot platforms listed in its official product portfolio.

name: Clearpath Robotics
description: Clearpath Robotics is a Canadian robotics company founded in June 2009, headquartered in Kitchener, Ontario, Canada, and its official website is clearpathrobotics.com; as of early 2026 the company employs roughly 70 people.

name: Comau
description: Comau’s official website is www.comau.com; the company is headquartered in Turin, Italy, was founded in 1973, and employs roughly 5,400 people as of the latest available data.

name: Dobot Robotics
description: Dobot Robotics, officially operating at www.dobot-robots.com, was founded in June 2015 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China; the company’s workforce has grown to roughly 501‑1,000 employees.

name: Doosan Robotics
description: Doosan Robotics is a South Korean robotics company founded in 2015, headquartered in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea, and its official website is www.doosanrobotics.com; the company employs roughly 236 people.

name: Elephant Robotics
description: Elephant Robotics (official website https://www.elephantrobotics.com/en/) is a Chinese high‑tech robotics company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China (Electronics and Technology Building, Futian District). The company’s publicly available sources do not provide a specific employee count.

name: EngineAI
description: EngineAI Robotics Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Shenzhen, China, was founded in October 2023, operates its official website at https://en.engineai.com.cn, and the company does not publicly disclose its total number of employees.

name: Engineered Arts
description: Engineered Arts Ltd, founded in 2004, is headquartered in Falmouth, Cornwall, England, operates its official website at https://engineeredarts.co.uk, and employs roughly 51 – 200 people.

name: Epson Robots
description: Epson Robots’ official website is www.epsonrobots.com; the company is headquartered in Los Alamitos, California, USA, was founded in 1975, and employs roughly 1,600 people (1,588 reported at the end of 2022).

name: Estun Automation
description: Estun Automation’s official website is www.estun.com; the company is headquartered at No. 1888 Jiyin Avenue, Jiangning Economic Development Zone, Nanjing, Jiangsu 211106, China; it was founded in 1993 and employs approximately 3,850 people.

name: FANUC
description: FANUC’s official website is www.fanuc.com; the company is headquartered in Oshino‑mura, Minamitsuru‑gun, Yamanashi Prefecture, Japan (address: 3580 Shibokusa, Yamanashi 401‑0597); it was founded in 1972 as an independent entity and today employs roughly 11,900 people worldwide.

name: Fauna Robotics
description: Fauna Robotics is an American robotics company that designs and assembles robots in the United States. Its Sprout platform brings developer workflows to humanoid robotics so teams can move from idea to prototype to deployment with less friction in homes, classrooms, and everyday human spaces. Fauna joined Amazon in March 2026 and says it continues selling Sprout Creator Edition robots and supporting existing customers.

name: Figure AI
description: Figure AI is an American robotics company developing general-purpose humanoid robots powered by AI. Founded in 2022 by Brett Adcock. Headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. Valued at $39B following September 2025 Series C. Backed by Microsoft, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Jeff Bezos, and Intel. BotQ production facility operational with 12,000 units/year capacity. BMW manufacturing partnership active. Figure 03 named TIME Best Invention of 2025.

name: Fourier Intelligence
description: Fourier Intelligence (often styled as Fourier Robotics) is a private Chinese robotics company founded in 2015, headquartered in Shanghai, China at No. 2388 Xiupu Road, Pudong District, and its official website is https://www.fftai.com; the firm employs roughly 30 people, with LinkedIn listing 29 current staff members.

name: Franka Robotics
description: Franka Robotics is a German research‑driven robotics company headquartered in Munich (Frei‑Otto‑Straße 20, 80797 Munich, Germany), founded in 2016, operates its official website at franka.de, and employs roughly 119 people as of early 2026.

name: Fujisoft
description: Fujisoft develops robotics platforms for industrial, service, and embodied AI use cases.

name: Hanson Robotics
description: Hanson Robotics is a private engineering and robotics company founded in 2007 by David Hanson; its headquarters are located in Hong Kong Science Park, Hong Kong, and its official website is hansonrobotics.com. The company employs roughly 58 people.

name: Hiwonder
description: Hiwonder’s official website is hiwonder.com; the company is headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China (Longgang District, Zaohekeng Industrial Park, No. 16, Building C, 201), it was founded in 2015 and has a workforce of roughly 51‑200 employees.

name: Leju Robotics
description: Leju Robotics, officially known as Leju (Shenzhen) Robotics Co., Ltd., operates from its headquarters in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China, was founded in 2016, maintains an official website at www.lejurobot.com (and the English portal www.lejurobot.com/en), and employs roughly 200 to 500 staff members.

name: LimX Dynamics
description: LimX Dynamics is a Shenzhen‑based robotics company whose official website is limxdynamics.com; it is headquartered on the 15th Floor, Building E, Nanshan I Valley, No. 3157 Shahexi Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, China; the company was founded in January 2022; and its workforce is reported to be in the range of roughly 50 to 200 employees.

name: Macco Robotics
description: Macco Robotics, founded in 2021, is headquartered in Málaga, Spain; its official website is https://www.maccorobotics.com, and the company employs roughly 11 to 50 people.

name: Mentee Robotics
description: Mentee Robotics, a developer of AI‑powered humanoid robots, is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel (address: 3 Arik Einstein, Herzliya 4659071, Israel), was founded in 2022, employs approximately 77 people, and its official website is https://menteebot.com.

name: Mitsubishi Electric Robotics
description: Mitsubishi Electric’s robotics business, best known for its MELFA robot line, is part of Mitsubishi Electric Corporation, which was founded in 1921 and is headquartered at the Tokyo Building, 2‑7‑3 Marunouchi, Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan; the company’s official website is www.mitsubishielectric.com (with a dedicated robotics section at www.mitsubishielec

name: Nachi-Fujikoshi
description: NACHI‑FUJIKOSHI Corp., the parent of Nachi‑Fujikoshi Robotics, was founded on 21 December 1928; its head office is at Shiodome Sumitomo Building 17F, 1‑9‑2 Higashi‑Shinbashi, Minato‑ku, Tokyo 105‑0021 Japan (with the principal manufacturing plant at 1‑1‑1 Fujikoshi‑Honmachi, Toyama 930‑8511), its official website is www.nachi‑fujikoshi.co.jp, and t

name: NEURA Robotics
description: NEURA Robotics is a German cognitive robotics company headquartered in Metzingen (near Stuttgart), Baden-Württemberg. Founded by CEO David Reger. Pioneer of cognitive robotics with patented artificial skin and touchless human detection. 4NE1 humanoid designed in collaboration with Studio F.A. Porsche. Powered by NVIDIA Isaac GR00T and Thor T5000 processor. R&D hub in Zurich, production in Germany and Hangzhou. Plans to move all production to Germany.

name: Omron Robotics
description: Omron Robotics is the robotics division of Omron Corporation, which was founded in 1933; the robotics business operates from its primary headquarters in Pleasanton, California, United States, and maintains additional locations in Amherst, New Hampshire and Barcelona, Spain; the division’s official website is https://robotics.omron.com/, and it empl

name: OnX Robotics
description: Onyx Robotics (official site onyx‑robotics.com) is a Boston‑based AI‑controls startup that operates out of the MassRobotics incubator; it was founded in 2023 and, as an early‑stage company, employs a small team of fewer than 50 people.

name: PAL Robotics
description: PAL Robotics’ official website is https://pal-robotics.com/, the company was founded in 2004, is headquartered in Barcelona, Spain, and employs roughly 51‑200 people.

name: Physical Robotics
description:
Physical Robotics presents itself as a robotics company building tangible, robot-first products—anchored by its Robot Pi initiative and a “Dream Team” narrative around experienced robotics talent.

The brand emphasizes hands-on engineering and a global network of contributors to move from ideas to working robots—aiming at practical, physical deployment rather than purely digital demos.

name: Promobot
description: Promobot’s official website is https://promo-bot.ai/, the company was founded in 2015, its headquarters are located at ul. Lunacharsky 77A, Perm 614087, Russian Federation, and it employs roughly 51‑200 people.

The company’s official website is https://www.qihan.com, and it employs rou

name: Rainbow Robotics
description: Rainbow Robotics was founded in 2011, is headquartered in the Yuseong District of Daejeon, South Korea, operates its official website at https://www.rainbow-robotics.com, and employs roughly 124 people.

name: Realbotix
description: Realbotix’s official website is www.realbotix.com, the company is headquartered in San Marcos, United States, it was founded in 2020, and it currently employs roughly 2‑10 people.

description: Richtech Robotics was founded in 2016, is headquartered at 2975 Lincoln Road in Las Vegas, Nevada, operates its official website at www.richtechrobotics.com, and employs roughly 55 people.

name: Robot Era
description: Robot Era’s official website is https://www.robotera.com/en/, the company is headquartered in Beijing, China, and it was founded in August 2023; while the exact employee count is not publicly disclosed, the firm maintains a growing team of dozens of engineers, researchers and support staff.

name: Robotis
description: Robotis, founded in 1999, is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea (37 Magok Jungang 5‑ro 1‑gil, Gangseo‑gu), operates its official website at https://en.robotis.com/, and employs roughly 51–200 people.

name: Sanctuary AI
description: Sanctuary AI, a robotics company focused on industrial‑grade humanoid robots, is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada (201 – 1825 Quebec Street), was founded in 2018, maintains its official website at www.sanctuary.ai, and employs roughly 140 people worldwide as of late 2025.

name: SIASUN Robot & Automation
description: SIASUN Robot & Automation Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000, is headquartered in the Hunnan District of Shenyang, China, runs its official website at www.siasun.com, and has a workforce of roughly 3,400 employees.

name: SoftBank Robotics
description: SoftBank Robotics’ official website is https://www.softbankrobotics.com/, its headquarters are in Tokyo, Japan, the company was founded in 2012, and it employs roughly 200‑500 people.

name: Staubli Robotics
description: Staubli Robotics is part of the Swiss industrial group Stäubli, whose official website is www.staubli.com; the company’s headquarters are located in Pfäffikon, in the canton of Schwyz, Switzerland, it was founded in 1892, and it employs roughly 6,000 people worldwide.

name: Techman Robot
description: Techman Robot, founded in 2015, is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan (5F, No. 58‑2 Huaya 2nd Road, Guishan District), operates its official website at www.tm-robot.com/en, and has a workforce of approximately 500‑1,000 employees as of 2024.

name: Tesla
description: Tesla’s robotics initiatives are presented on the company’s official website at www.tesla.com, with the broader corporate site serving as the primary portal for information on its Optimus robot and related projects; the company’s headquarters are now located in Austin, Texas, having relocated from Palo Alto, California, and Tesla was founded in 200

name: Toyota
description: Toyota Research Institute, the robotics and artificial‑intelligence subsidiary of Toyota Motor Corporation, operates from its headquarters in Los Altos, California, USA; it was founded in 2016 and its official website is tri.global, and the organization now employs roughly 430 people.

name: UBTECH Robotics
description: UBTECH Robotics is a Shenzhen-based humanoid robotics company, publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (09880.HK). Founded 2012, backed by Tencent. First humanoid robot IPO globally (Dec 2023). Partnerships with Airbus (aviation manufacturing), BYD, Foxconn, FAW-Volkswagen, Geely, Texas Instruments, and Siemens (digital twin manufacturing). Total humanoid robot orders exceeded 1.4 billion yuan (~$200M) in 2025, ranking #1 globally. Production capacity targeting 10,000 industrial humanoid units by 2026. ~1,000 Walker S2 units produced as of late 2025.

name: Unitree Robotics
description: Unitree Robotics (Hangzhou Yushu Technology Co., Ltd.) is the world's largest humanoid robot company by unit volume. Founded in 2016 by CEO Wang Xingxing, the company shipped 5,500+ humanoid robots in 2025 and targets 20,000 units in 2026. Unitree commands 70% of the global quadruped robot market with 50,000+ units shipped. The company filed for a ~$610M IPO on Shanghai's STAR Market in March 2026.

name: Universal Robots
description: Universal Robots is a Danish robotics company founded in 2005, headquartered in Odense, Denmark, with its official website at www.universal-robots.com, and employs approximately 1,000 people worldwide.

name: VinRobotics
description:
VinRobotics presents a human-first view of robotics: technology built to serve people, not replace them.

With a heart-shaped logo symbolizing harmony between humans and robots, the brand positions humane design and real-world usefulness as the standard for how robotics should show up in everyday life.

name: Xiaomi Robotics
description:
Xiaomi Robotics is Xiaomi Corporation’s robotics division, based on the Xiaomi Campus in Beijing, China, and known publicly for its CyberOne humanoid robot.

Backed by Xiaomi’s scale and product engineering culture, the group signals an ambition to translate consumer electronics, AI, and manufacturing discipline into practical robotics R&D and prototypes showcased through Xiaomi’s official channels.

name: XPENG Robotics
description: XPENG Robotics, the robotics arm of XPENG Inc., operates from its headquarters in Shenzhen, China, was launched in 2021, maintains its public presence at https://www.xpeng.com/robotics, and employs a few hundred staff members (approximately 200‑300 people).
